title: Maximal Multipoint Seshadri Constants in Higher Dimensions
displayName: Maximal Multipoint Seshadri Constants in Higher Dimensions

statements.checked: Smooth integral complex projective X, n≥3, ample L; exists r0 depending on X,L, for every integer r≥r0 exists countable union Zr of proper closed subsets in distinct ordered tuples with nonempty complement; ordinary unweighted curve constant equals (L^n/r)^(1/n); equivalent blow-up real class nef and top self-intersection zero.
n≥2, positive real intercepts, additive supports in every degree, d=max(3/A,2/B), dw<1/16; same cardinality, additivity and backward finite-jet surjectivity after replacing A,B by w,AB/w.

proofPassages.scope: Least terms, labels, analytic weighted limits, persistence of full jet rank, unimodular maps, coordinate compression.
Complete-intersection flag; global divisibility; final curve degree; finite-degree weight choice and backward transfer.
Full two-coordinate construction, node bound, primitive direction, unchanged labels and degree-independent exact supports.
Uniform two-summand interior saturation; CRT interpolation; translate smaller simplex inside interior.
Common threshold, countable simultaneous open loci, Baire nonemptiness, ordinary multiplicities via Hilbert–Samuel, blow-up upper bound and nefness.

externalSources.displayName: Maximal Seshadri constants on arbitrary polarized surfaces
externalSources.checking: Read Proposition 3.2 p8, Proposition 3.4 pp9–10, Lemma 4.3 p14; checked methodological antecedent only. The higher-dimensional manuscript reproves its adaptation and explicitly does not use the surface maximality theorem.

dependencies.role: Node exponent bound, diagonal compression and primitive direction are adapted to labelled polynomial spaces and surjective full-dimensional jets. Surface maximality is not an input.
dependencies.checking: Statements and referring passages checked; higher-dimensional adaptation proof read.

unresolved: No independent formal or specialist verification of the complete proof.

External historical results of Nagata, Biran, Küchle, Roé–Ross, Demailly, Ito, Okounkov, Lazarsfeld–Mustaţă, Kaveh–Khovanskii and Dumnicki were not separately checked: not used as black-box proof inputs in this digest.
No claim extending this theorem to dimension 2, all r≥10, arbitrary characteristic, weighted constants or higher-cycle constants.
Exact threshold is not optimized. The manuscript supplies a sufficient choice through equation (6.1).
